entries.text: 我等你很久了，火之挑战者！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_akamatsu_01

entries.text: 这么快就挑战四天王，\n你好厉害啊！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_akamatsu_30

entries.text: 难怪乌栗和\n杜若前辈这么喜欢你。[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_akamatsu_31

entries.text: 老实说，\n我也很在意你哦。[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_akamatsu_32

entries.text: 但是，我赤松的挑战\n一点都不轻松哦！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_akamatsu_33

entries.text: 我的四天王挑战是\n……[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]制作超辣的三明治[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_akamatsu_02

entries.text: 制作让我赤松\n也能辣得直叫唤的\r\n超～辣三明治吧！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_akamatsu_03

entries.text: 你肯定觉得太简单了吧？\n但是，我不会让你用自己的食材哦。[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_akamatsu_04

entries.text: 你要通过和周围的联盟社社员\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]周旋[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]来获得食材。[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_akamatsu_34

entries.text: 等你觉得食材收集好了，\n就回来找我吧。[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_akamatsu_05

entries.text: 我会让你在我的眼前\n制作三明治的。[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_akamatsu_06

entries.text: 料理的诀窍主要在于食材的选择！\n只要这个不搞错，就是小事一桩哦。[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_akamatsu_07

entries.text: 好了，[VAR 0x0100(0000)]，\n要开始四天王挑战吗？[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_akamatsu_08

entries.text: 我要挑战！
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_select_01

entries.text: 听说明
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_select_02

entries.text: 下次吧
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_select_03

entries.text: 好咧～！\n给我３分钟的准备时间！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_akamatsu_09

entries.text: 首先通过和联盟社社员周旋\n来获得食材吧。[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_akamatsu_10

entries.text: 要制作的是[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]超辣的三明治[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]！\n你大概知道需要些什么吧？[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.text: 收集到足够开始制作料理的\n食材后，就告诉我一声吧！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.text: 那么～现在开始！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.text: 我非～常厉害哦，\n你一定会后悔的。

entries.text: 蛋、油和醋！\n给我看看它们混在一起能做出什么～！
